svg.title: The newline's vector travels through the language model: scaled up by the square root of 2048, through the four steps of a decoder layer 18 times, back to RMS 1 in the final norm, and out of lm_head as one row of logits

g.text: follow the newline's vector from the merge to the logits
a text vector grows from length
the gated MLP adds its correction
layers 0 to 17, the same four steps
final RMSNorm, the vector back to RMS 1
the last row, after the newline, is the next word
